title: Affine base-change composition lifts through full affine inclusion
statement: Let U_h be affine-site functors [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site] and t_h identify their inclusions with ordinary etale base change [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. There exists a family gamma_f,g: U_f U_g isomorphic to U_(gf). Its hom component followed by t_(gf) equals t_g at U_f(V), followed by base change of t_f(V), followed by the inverse pullbackComp component. No continuity, adjunction or sheaf comparison data are required.

proof.text: Conjugate the canonical pullback comparison by t_f, t_g and t_(gf), then cancel the fully faithful inclusion using Mathlib Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight. Map-preimage and cancellation of t_(gf) give the displayed equation.
